recentItems.title: LIVE | Sandu, Zelenskyy and Dan – in the capital of MOLDOVA: joint BRIEFING of leaders
recentItems.description:
On the Independence Day of the Republic of Moldova, a trilateral meeting of delegations from Moldova, Romania and Ukraine is taking place. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Moldovan President Maia Sandu and Romanian President Nicușor Dan are discussing key issues of regional security, infrastructure cooperation and the European integration movement. Following the talks, the heads of state will make a joint appearance before the press.
